programme.desc: When the first manned flight to Mars is scrubbed on the launch pad, anxious authorities must scramble to save face and retain their funding - and so a plot to fake a Martian landing is hatched.

programme.title: Made In England: Powell & Pressburger
programme.desc: Martin Scorsese reflects on the influence of filmmakers Michael Powell and Emeric Pressburger, whose decades-long collaboration led to a series of classics that made the duo a crucial part of British cinema.

programme.title: Meek's Cutoff
programme.desc: The year is 1845 and a wagon team of three families is setting off across the sparse terrain of the Oregon desert, in northwest USA. Starring Michelle Williams alongside Paul Dano.

programme.title: Unforgiven
programme.desc: A Western saga of a man who cannot escape his violent destiny. Heroes and legends rise and fall on the harsh American frontier.

programme.title: The Assassination Of Jesse James
programme.desc: Robert Ford is fascinated by the daring, ruthless and grand persona of the most notorious outlaw Jesse James. He helps Jesse in his crimes, till one day he decides to become famous, and kills Jesse.

programme.title: Rendition
programme.desc: A political thriller about an Egyptian-born man who mysteriously disappears on a flight from South Africa to Washington and the government conspiracy put in place to cover it up. (Reese Witherspoon)

programme.title: UNindian
programme.desc: Highlighting the complexities of wooing another from a different culture, UnIndian is a cross-cultural romantic comedy with a lot of heart and a little spice.

programme.title: A River Runs Through It
programme.desc: Two brothers bond with their father, a minister, over fly fishing. The brothers are raised to adhere to their father's strict moral code, though this is easier for one, than it is for the other.

programme.title: Dean Spanley
programme.desc: England, 1904. After attending a talk on reincarnation with his son, Horatio Fisk (Peter O'Toole) meets an affable cleric named Dean Spanley (Sam Neill) who shares stories of his past life as a dog.

programme.title: Motherhood
programme.desc: A female high school student named Sayaka kills herself, but the reason why is unknown. Sayaka appeared to have a normal life with her family.

programme.title: The Dead Don't Hurt
programme.desc: On the 1860s American frontier, a fiercely independent woman must survive alone among corrupt men while her lover fights in the Civil War, forcing them to confront who they have become.

programme.title: The Shooting
programme.desc: A mysterious woman persuades two cowboys to help her in a revenge scheme.

programme.title: A Canterbury Tale
programme.desc: From the Powell and Pressburger team comes a contemporary version of Chaucer's classic poems. Four people, each with their own blessing or penance to seek, journey to Canterbury to find their answers.

programme.title: Charro!
programme.desc: Vince Hackett's gang steals a prized victory cannon from Mexico and blames the deed on ex-gang member Jess Wade, who wants to go straight.

programme.title: Body Of Lies
programme.desc: Roger Ferris (Leonardo DiCaprio) is the best man U.S. Intelligence has on the ground, in places where human life is worth no more than the information it can get you.

programme.title: Nymphomaniac Vol 1
programme.desc: Lars Von Trier's Nymphomaniac is the wild and poetic two-part story of a woman's journey from birth to the age of fifty. A self-diagnosed nymphomaniac recounts her erotic experiences to the man who saved her after a beating.

programme.title: The Nature Of Love
programme.desc: Sylvain is a craftsman, renovating Sophia and Xavier's new country house. When Sophia and Sylvain meet, Sophia's world is turned upside down. Opposites attract, but can they last?
